confidence_notes: Food anchors use Tangier price observations, though crowd-sourced samples are limited. Cocktail is estimated at about 1.75 times the local draft beer price; wine by the glass at about 1.25 times beer. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate, not based on live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: No cross-city proxy used; food anchors follow Tangier-specific price observations, while accommodation reflects general knowledge of the city’s summer tourism market.
